title: pvAnnotateTimeFilter
body:
## pvAnnotateTimeFilter

Produces a one-row text table showing the input's current time, transformed as time × Scale + Shift and formatted with an fmt-style Format such as "Time: {time:.3f} s". Use it to label animations or images with physical time. It needs a time-dependent input; pvAnnotateTime is the source variant that needs no input.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Format uses fmt/Python brace syntax with the name time; old printf patterns such as "%f" are converted with a warning.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AnnotateTimeFilter`. Identity: `filters/TimeToTextConvertor`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input dataset for which to display the time. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":[],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Format` | The value of this property is a format string used to display the input time. The format string is specified using fmt style | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Scale` | The factor by which the input time is scaled. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Shift` | The amount of time the input is shifted (after scaling). | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

```json
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }

```
